ios.desc:
Fuzion transforms your portrait photos into stunning masterpieces in seconds. From breathtaking double exposures to vintage film effects, the creative possibilities are endless.

With Fuzion, you can effortlessly import any photo from your library. Our advanced AI automatically separates people or pets from the background, turning your ordinary snapshots into stunning edits. The intuitive interface and 1-tap presets make it easy to dive right in.

- Apply amazing effects instantly with 1-tap presets
- Unleash your creativity with filters, light and dust overlays, stickers, and more
- Replace the background in the photo with a single tap
- Create beautiful double exposures
- Perfect for editing photos of people and pets

Share your creations with the world! Use the hashtag #MadeWithFuzion or tag us for a chance to be featured on our Instagram.

We value your feedback and suggestions. Contact us at contact@fuzion.photo
